datasets.name: 96e65a6f
queryLines:
SELECT
    p.episode_id,
    a.day,
    a.phase,
    a.step_index,
    a.seat_index,
    p.player_id,
    p.model_name,
    p.role,
    p.team,
    a.action_type,
    a.target_id,
    a.message,
    a.reasoning,
    a.perceived_threat_level,
    CASE WHEN a.perceived_threat_level = 'SAFE' THEN 0
        WHEN a.perceived_threat_level = 'UNEASY' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END AS perceived_threat_level_int,
    a.prompt_tokens,
    a.completion_tokens,
    a.reported_cost
FROM silver.players p
INNER JOIN silver.actions a
ON p.episode_id = a.episode_id AND p.player_id = a.actor_id

lines:
## Kaggle LLM Werewolf Data Analysis *or, "Good call- you're absolutely right. I am a bloodthirsty night-beast, great catch!"* ### Overview - **Werewolf ** is (per Kaggle) "...a multiplayer social deduction game in which an informed minority (the werewolves) must deceive an uninformed majority (the villagers) to win." - Small number of werewolves collaborate to (\**ehem\**) "eliminate" villagers one-by-one, while attempting to avoid scrutiny and cast suspicion on other players - Villagers collaborate to identify and (\**ehem\**) "exile" the werewolves before the werewolves obtain the majority - Kaggle pits LLMs against each other as a benchmark to test communication, collaboration, and complex strategic thinking - Provide game outcomes as JSON files for public exploration ### Goals - Build an ETL pipeline to parse gameplay JSON files into a full bronze/silver/gold medallion architecture - Create dashboards to explore game progression, compare model performance, identify factors affecting game outcomes, and flag strong/weak model pairs. - Implement unified version control for all resources (pipeline, kickoff job, dashboard) using DABs ### Data pipeline - **Landing: ** - **Bronze:** Streaming ingestion of normalized JSON, excluding large unused payloads. - **Silver:** Structured episodes, players, actions, and events. - **Gold:** Model/team performance summaries and a game timeline. - A file-arrival job triggers one serverless Lakeflow pipeline containing Python and SQL definitions. ### Bundle deployment - The `werewolf-etl` Databricks bundle manages the pipeline, kickoff job, and dashboard together. - `databricks.yml` configures the production workspace, catalog, source volume, and SQL warehouse. - **Release flow:** Validate → Review deployment plan → Deploy → Verify dashboard publication.

 

https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/kaggle/werewolf/versions/1

# Game progression

Choose one episode. Circles are actions; vote targets appear above them. Diamonds show elected targets, squares show successful saves, and red crosses show actual eliminations. Hover a marker for its full reasoning, message, and event details. Use the episode and day/night controls to narrow the detail table below. Day and night columns have different shading. Rounds follow recorded player order when available; otherwise actions retain individual step positions.
